cases.title: Aster-9
cases.text: The Aster-9 thermal controller has a maximum continuous operating temperature of 74 °C.

cases.title: NexoFlow M4
cases.text: The NexoFlow M4 requires preventive service every 600 operating hours.

cases.title: Helix-R
cases.text: The Helix-R battery module uses lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) cells.

cases.title: QuantaGate Q7
cases.text: The QuantaGate Q7 indicates a successful self-test by flashing blue three times.

cases.title: Meridia V3
cases.text: The specified closing torque for the Meridia V3 isolation-valve stem nut is 18 N·m.

cases.title: DeltaCell D2
cases.text: The DeltaCell D2 may be stored at 20% to 60% relative humidity, non-condensing.

cases.title: Solace V2
cases.text: To enter recovery mode on the Solace V2, hold the RESET button for 8 seconds while power is applied.

cases.title: Orion-R12
cases.text: The Orion-R12 relay is rated for a maximum load of 12 A at 24 V DC.

cases.title: Vanta-P8
cases.text: The Vanta-P8 intake filter uses an 80-micrometre mesh.

cases.title: Kestrel-K1
cases.text: Zero calibration of the Kestrel-K1 uses certified nitrogen at 99.999% purity.
